title: Grateful Dead Live at Stanley Theater on 1969-02-07
lineage: SBD > MC > DAT > HHb > CDR > EAC (secure) > CD Wave > Cool Edit Pro > SHN (seekable)

ai_review.summary: Soundboard recording with a touch of tape hiss captures a near‑peak 1969 show highlighted by a scorching Dark Star, William Tell and an Eleven→Love‑Light blaze.
ai_review.review: The early‑‘69 performance is praised as one of the band’s peak‑period shows – a powerful Dark Star opener, a ripping William Tell, and a second‑set that bursts through with Alligator > Caution, Eleven and Love‑Light. The SBD source is generally balanced and clear despite some vintage tape hiss and occasional power‑loss quirks, making the music highly listenable.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers give 4–5 stars and highlight exceptional musical moments; recording is described as good with only minor hiss, yielding a strong overall score.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Balanced SBD mix from a cassette master; noticeable old‑tape hiss and brief power‑loss moments but overall clear and satisfying sound.

show_quality.setlist_flow: A strong opening Dark Star sets the tone, followed by tight early‑set work; the second set delivers superlative jams and seamless transitions, especially the Eleven→Love‑Light climax.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Guitar described as perfect tone, shooting sparks and intense throughout.
band_member_comments.Phil: Bass hints at New Potato/13s in Cryptical reprise; his playing and vocal shouts help “tear the roof off” despite occasional power‑loss muddiness.
band_member_comments.Drums: Bill Kreutzmann and Mickey Hart praised for ripping the roof off with driving, high‑energy drumming.
